title: Resolving AdaBoost Cycling with LLMs: A Computer-Assisted Counterexample
abstract: arXiv:2604.07055v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a computer-assisted counterexample to the open question of whether exhaustive AdaBoost always converges to a finite cycle, posed by Rudin, Schapire, and Daubechies in COLT 2012. The construction is based on a block-product of two small AdaBoost instances whose two factors share an exact period-2 orbit for their five-step branch maps, but whose linearized return maps have dominant eigenvalues with an irrational logarithmic ratio. This irrationality forces the sequence of instances that win each round of updates to have an irrational asymptotic frequency, which precludes convergence to a finite cycle. The resulting counterexample has 2,500 examples, weak-learning margin $1/5$, and a uniform initial distribution, and it holds under every maximizing tie rule. All finite computations in the proof are certified by rational arithmetic in SymPy, with SageMath verifying the main inequalities. We also document the collaborative work

translated_title: 利用大语言模型解决 AdaBoost 循环问题：一个计算机辅助的反例
translated_abstract: 我们针对 Rudin、Schapire 和 Daubechies 在 COLT 2012 上提出的公开问题——穷举式 AdaBoost 是否总是收敛到一个有限循环——构造了一个计算机辅助的反例。该构造基于两个小型 AdaBoost 实例的块乘积：两个因子在各自的五步分支映射上共享一个精确的周期-2 轨道，但其线性化回归映射的优势特征值具有无理的对数比值。这种无理性迫使每轮更新中获胜实例的序列具有无理的渐近频率，从而排除了收敛到有限循环的可能性。所得反例包含 2,500 个样本，弱学习器边际为 1/5，初始分布为均匀分布，并且在任何最大化平局规则下均成立。证明中的所有有限计算均通过 SymPy 中的有理数算术进行认证，并由 SageMath 验证主要不等式。我们还记录了相关的协作工作
tldr: 本文通过计算机辅助构造了一个包含 2,500 个样本的反例，证明穷举式 AdaBoost 并不总是收敛到有限循环，从而解决了 Rudin、Schapire 和 Daubechies 提出的长期公开问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a computer-assisted counterexample with 2,500 examples showing that exhaustive AdaBoost does not always converge to a finite cycle, resolving the open question posed by Rudin, Schapire, and Daubechies.
